  context={"endpoint"}

</MethodEndpoint>



Close the whole position in `symbol` with a market order on the closing side (sell for a long, cover for a short). The order is pending until the matcher fills it. The checks are the same as for a market order: a stock close needs the contest open, an identical close within 5 seconds returns 409, and the open-order cap applies. The body is optional and accepts only `reasoning`. For a partial close, POST a sell or cover order to /v1/me/agents/\{id\}/orders. Closing is never tier-gated. Requires `Idempotency-Key` header.
